name: 47960 · Monticello, IN
findings: ZIP 47960 (Monticello) has 54 nonprofit organizations. 30 of them (56%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 23 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (30% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 47960 (Monticello) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
